summary_en: Sompo Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 15 million shares (1.70% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 68.0 billion yen from December 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The company simultaneously approved cancellation of 49.67 million shares (5.32% of issued shares before cancellation) effective November 30, 2026.

summary_en: 17.0M shares (1.90% of outstanding), ¥69.0B upper limit, acquisition window June 2 – November 18, 2026. Comprises ¥35.4B base return (50% of adjusted consolidated profit, 3-year average) and ¥33.6B supplementary return (50% of net gains from policy stock disposals after tax), financed within capital-level adjustment framework alongside dividend.
